headline: SIX BRIDGES FOR COAST GREEN THIS SUMMER
content: The six bridges between San Isidro and Barranco will be ready for this summer's vacation season according to EMAPE. They cover access points along the beaches via Malecones. With investments totaling 25 million Soles, construction works on expanding beach circuits to six lanes from San Isidro to Chorrillos will pause during peak tourist months.

headline: ELECTION PROMISES FROM SURCO MAYORS’ CANDIDATES
